SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - AUGUST 7, 2025 - 05:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AUGUST 7, 2025

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  Commissioner Iglesias led in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Alex Camargo
  Commissioner Jose Iglesias
  Vice Chair Pat Patnaik
  Chair Ileana Prado

  ABSENT:  Commissioner Cathy DeLeon (Excused)

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present, except
  Commissioner DeLeon, whose absence was excused .

4.  Presentations
4A.  Presentations

  Acting Recreation Services Superintendent Samir Patel recognized Recreation Leaders
  II Alexandra Cabriales and Marcell Frazier as Employees of the Month for June.

  Mr. Patel recognized Employee of the Quarter for April through June for the Cerritos
  Senior Center, Michelson Gutierrez.
5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  There were no public comments.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A  Approval of Minutes – Thursday, June 5, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: Commissioner Iglesias moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as
  presented. Commissioner Camargo seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with
  Commissioner DeLeonabsent.
 City of Cerritos  August 7, 2025
Parks and Recreation Commission Minutes  Page 2
7.  New and Old Business
7A.  Reviewand considerationof an informational review of the 52-dAnnual Let Freedom
  Ring Celebration held on July 4, 2025.

  Recreation Services Administrator Stefanie Linn displayed a PowerPoint presentation
  with details of the event.

  Members of the Commission commented favorably regarding the event.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the number of attendees at the event.

  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to receive and file the report. Commissioner Patnaik
  seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner DeLeon absent.

7B.  Reviewand considerationof an informational review of the 2025 Grandparent’sDay
  and S.P.I.C.E program held at the Cerritos Senior Center.

  Community Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala displayed a PowerPoint presentation with
  details of the report.

  Discussion followed regarding attracting more households to participate.

  Therewere no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Commissioner Patnaik moved to receive and file the report. Commissioner
  Camargo seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner DeLeon absent.

7C.  Review and consideration, pursuant to the City of Cerritos commission and committee
  scopeof authority (policy 6.02), of a Commissioner’ssuggestionfor a Commission-
  initiated special evaluationproject of a 5K run event as part of the 2026 Spring Fling
  and Fireworks SpectacularCelebrating the City’s 70th Anniversary.

  Mr. Patel provided details of the report.

  Discussion followed regarding the pros and cons of the options provided and adding a
  5K walk to Option 1.

  MOTION: Commissioner Iglesias moved to approve Option 1 of the agenda report
  associated with this item, as amended, adding a 5K walk to the event. Chair Prado
  secondedthe motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner DeLeon absent.

  Discussionfollowed regarding needing Council approval for a feasibility study to
  research the matter.

  There were no public comments on this issue.
 City of Cerritos  August 7, 2025
Parks and Recreation Commission Minutes  Page 3

8.  Reports
8A.  Reportsfrom DesignatedCommissionStaff Liaison
  Ms. Linn announced the Community Services Program will now be digital and provided
  an update on Recreation Services programs, classes, and activities.

  Mr. Zavala provided details of Senior Center programs, classes and activities, including
  recent and upcoming excursions.

  Membersof the Commission commented favorably on Senior Center events.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the upcoming Community Development Open House
  regarding potential rezoning of a shopping center, demand for the Pageant of the
  Mastersexcursion, and the possibility of expanding transportation to the event.

  MOTION: Commissioner Camargo moved to receive and file the report.
  Commissioner Patnaik seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner
  DeLeon absent.

8B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  Chair Prado and Commissioner Iglesias reported attending the AAPI LEAD Summit
  Conference in Atlanta, Georgia.

  Commissioner Patnaik reported visiting a park in Yorba Linda and commented
  favorably regarding Cerritos Parks.

  Commissioner Iglesias commented on the recent Annual Soccer Youth Awards at
  Heritage Park.

  Membersof the Commissioncommented favorably about the event.

  At the discretion of the Chair, Chair Prado invited public comments. General public
  comments and suggestions are generally reserved for Agenda Item 5.

  Cerritos resident, Teddy Lloyd, talked about the City moving forward with pickleball
  courts; asked the Commission to consider opening them earlier in the day to avoid the
  heat and closing them later at night.

9.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 5:54 p.m.

  /s/Samir Patel
  Samir Patel
  Acting Secretary
